design_rationale.01 - Foundations: Unifies ai-course Foundations and Overview with master-ai AI Foundations: the definitional hierarchy of AI/ML/DL, history, applications, and data-science foundations.

design_rationale.03 - Python and Data Tooling: ai-course Python and Data Tooling (environment, programming, libraries, data cleaning) — the tooling track has no master-ai counterpart.
design_rationale.04 - Machine Learning: Unifies both vaults' classical ML: regression, optimization, KNN, SVM, clustering/dimensionality reduction, trees, evaluation, generalization, reinforcement learning.
design_rationale.05 - Neural Network Foundations: Unifies ai-course NN/DL foundations (deep: backprop derivations, training dynamics, labs) with master-ai Neural Networks (concise architecture/training notes).
design_rationale.06 - Computer Vision: ai-course CNN track merged with its Image Processing track into one vision area (classical IP + learned CNN pipelines).
design_rationale.07 - Sequence Models: ai-course sequence models track (recurrence, LSTM/GRU, seq2seq, pitfalls).
design_rationale.08 - Attention and Transformers: Heaviest cross-vault merge: ai-course Attention/Transformers + master-ai Attention Mechanisms + master-ai Transformers.
design_rationale.09 - NLP and Language Models: master-ai NLP fundamentals (tokenization, embeddings, language modeling, pre-transformer NLP).
design_rationale.10 - Large Language Models: master-ai LLM internals (architecture, capabilities, context/KV cache, evaluation, limitations, sampling).
design_rationale.11 - Foundation Models and Multimodal: master-ai Foundation Models + Multimodal AI unified into one modern-models area.
design_rationale.12 - Generative Models: ai-course generative track (autoencoders, VAEs, GANs, diffusion).
design_rationale.13 - Training and Adaptation: master-ai Training + Fine-Tuning (data, distributed, optimization, pretraining, PEFT/RLHF).
design_rationale.14 - Inference and Production: master-ai Inference + AI Infrastructure + LLMOps/MLOps + Production AI.
design_rationale.15 - Agents and Tooling: master-ai Agents + Multi-Agent + RAG + Memory + MCP + Frameworks and Tools.
design_rationale.16 - Interpretability and Research: master-ai Interpretability + Research Frontiers + Model Architecture Research.
design_rationale.17 - Papers: master-ai Papers notes organized by research theme.
design_rationale.19 - Reference and Practice: ai-course quiz/question banks + master-ai Glossary + Interview Prep — first-class practice and reference material.
design_rationale.20 - Vault and Project Context: ARCHIVAL CONTEXT LAYER (not ordinary knowledge notes): the source vaults' own construction documents (merge reports, roadmaps, iteration logs, research queue with evidence-status labels). Retained as clearly-labeled internal context; the release audit decides its final presentation. Ordinary notes never narrate merges (SOURCE_POLICY).
